title: NIRF - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: NIRF - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: Lady Irwin College is a constituent college of the University of Delhi located in Delhi. The college provides contact information, quick links for students, and details on college timing and site visitors. It is accredited by NAAC with an A+ rating and holds a NIRF ranking of 31. The college’s admission enquiry number is 014836, and visitors are welcome from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm, with the website noting 2026 as a reference year.
